title: Two separately named 'drowned' locations exist with near-identical theming: 'the drowned shrine' (an Ashwood-adjacent Verses location for the Hollow King quest) and 'the drowned nave' / 'the drowned congregation' (a full, separate Fenmarch side-quest chain). Fully resolving the Fenmarch drowned-nave content (hauling and ringing the saint's bell, settling the congregation) did not advance the Three Verses tracker at all — only checking status made this clear.
where: Fenmarch: The Drowned Nave vs. Ashwood: Drowned Shrine
